verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity's own docs include an Identity-specific guide stating that Stripe generates events each time a verification session changes status, and that walks through implementing webhooks so an app is notified when results are available. That is a documented outbound HTTP callback mechanism a programmatic consumer can receive. missing for 10: an enumerated list of Identity event types, documentation of endpoint registration, signature verification and retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Stripe generates events every time a session changes status. In this guide, we’ll implement webhooks to notify your app when verification results become available.
Listen for verification results so your integration can automatically trigger reactions.
